provenance.source: experiments/voice-trim/fixtures/ (8 authored clips, reused — the SPEC names this set) + 4 derived synthetic samples (AC5)
provenance.nature: TTS-rendered dictation corpus, occupancy-tiered (en-e01-o45/o65, zh-d*-o85/o65/o45). The authored reference is the text the TTS was given (transcripts.json), so the ground truth is by construction, not model-labelled. Every sample is synthetic:true (TTS). The 4 derived samples (AC5) are TTS audio re-cut — no human recording is fabricated.

self-correction.note: authored self-correction 嗯不对; the FIRST within-turn pause (the clause boundary before 嗯不对) is the correction point

annotationPolicy.unit: candidate point = the ONSET of a silence run inside one instruction, where every detector is asked END/CONTINUE
annotationPolicy.onset: the first frame whose RMS < SILENCE_RMS after a speech frame; the interrogation point for every group
annotationPolicy.withinTurnPause: a silence run of 250–1500 ms with speech after it ⇒ CONTINUE (the authored reference is a single instruction)
annotationPolicy.correction: a within-turn pause at an authored self-correction boundary ⇒ CORRECTION: a naive pipeline commits the superseded instruction, so the prediction is scored separately (must-supersede), never as a false cutoff
annotationPolicy.turnEnd: the onset of the trailing silence (the frame after the last speech frame) ⇒ END
annotationPolicy.excluded: silence runs > 1500 ms are recorded under excludedPauses and NOT scored — occupancy-injected gaps are ambiguous ground truth
annotationPolicy.asymmetry: the interrogation point is common but the reaction is not: StreamingVad can only answer after its own 400 ms of silence (so a pause ≥ 400 ms is a commit to END before the speaker resumes), while Smart Turn answers at the onset from the content of the preceding 8 s

sampleBreakdown.note: denominator = candidate POINTS (the unit every group answers), not clips
